title: Rigorous construction of interacting quantum field theory in four dimensions
bottleneck: No interacting quantum field theory in four spacetime dimensions has ever been constructed with full mathematical rigor satisfying the Wightman or Haag-Kastler axioms. The Standard Model, the most successful theory in science, lacks a rigorous mathematical existence proof.
why_it_blocks: Physics relies on perturbation theory and lattice approximations that work in practice but are not known to define the theories they approximate; Hilbert's sixth problem, the axiomatization of physics, remains open at its core.
current_state: Constructive field theory has built rigorous models in two and three dimensions, and recent work claims progress on kinetic limits, but four-dimensional interacting theories remain beyond rigorous reach. Algebraic quantum field theory provides rigorous frameworks for free theories, yet interacting models in four dimensions still escape construction.
